text:
Rae (PMM): Quick kickoff — Evercrest customer story. Need to lock interview slots, get quote approvals, legal ok on excerpts, and confirm embargo window. Customer prefers week of Apr 11. Can @Jordi + @Kelsey confirm availability? Also need lead routing for post-launch webinar. TL;DR: 2x 30m interviews, one launch blog + webinar clip. :sparkles:

Jordi (Producer): I'm free Apr 12 & 13 afternoons PT. Will do recording + short b-roll. Need consent form signed beforehand. I can produce a 3-min highlight clip. @Rae can you share the question set?

Liam (Legal): Heads up — we'll need 72h turnaround on any quote redlines. If quotes touch PHI/PII, customer must sign off with legal redlines. Also require mention of data retention for recordings in contract. Tagging @Kelsey to confirm customer ok.

Kelsey (CS): Evercrest agreed to 2x30m on Apr 12 at 1pm PT and Apr 13 at 9am PT. I'll send calendar invites and the consent doc now. They asked for embargo until Apr 25. We'll push for Apr 20 if PR needs it. Also they want to review final 3 pull quotes.

DocusignBot: Consent form sent to alice@evercrest.com — link: https://docusign.example/abc123

Amir (Sales Ops): For webinar lead routing — propose SFDC campaign: Evercrest_Case_Q2, map leads to SDR East/EMEA using rule set. Quick mapping below:

```csv
email,region,sdr_queue,lead_source
{{lead.email}},EMEA,sdri-emea,evercrest-case
{{lead.email}},NA,sdri-na,evercrest-case
```

Amir (Sales Ops): Also recommend tagging lead with `benchmark_interest` if they attended the benchmarking demo. We'll add to nurture flow and include a link to the benchmark whitepaper in the follow-up sequence.

Rae (PMM): Perfect. @Liam we've got embargo Apr 25 (maybe Apr 20). Please confirm legal ok for 72h redline and PHI note. @Jordi I'll DM the question set and the one-pager. Once quotes are locked, we'll run them through the quote checklist (`author`, `attribution`, `legal-approved`).

Jordi (Producer): noted — will prep recording kit + quick guide for customer (mic, quiet room, examples). I'll also capture 1-2 b-roll clips during session.

Kelsey (CS): Sent invites and consent followed up. Client asked if we can share a short transcript for their records. Is that ok @Liam?

Liam (Legal): Yes but redact any identifiers; we can provide sanitized transcript. Also log approvals in the PR folder for audit.

Rae (PMM): Thanks all — I'll create a Trello ticket and drop assets into /campaigns/evercrest/. Will follow up on the quote deadlines and finalize launch date once legal confirms. :checkered_flag:
